This Week on Kickstarter

NOVEMBER 20, 2012
There's plenty of gratitude to go around in the world of Kickstarter. Creators and
backers are giving thanks to each other as projects come to life and rewards land in
mailboxes. And we're grateful for the amazing ideas we see every day — including
this week's thanks-worthy trio.

Saucy Magazine: Dangerous Food

All the food that's fit to print
Saucy is a food magazine with a kick. Along
with drool-inducing photography and thoughtful
recipes (like this guide to the ultimate
Thanksgiving sandwich) Saucy shares stories
from the kitchen's darker side, including deadly
snacks, diabolical eating habits, and the
elusive art of satiation. Sounds like perfect
reading material for the season of ritual feasts.

When their powers combine
Sportsfriends unites four uniquely hilarious
multiplayer games designed to incite
pandemonium in your living room. Each game
celebrates the experience of playing with other
humans in the same physical space,
melding forward-thinking interactive
experiments and simple, addictive fun. The
creators have shared their games at festivals,
exhibitions, and even in the middle of a Danish
street — but this is the first chance to bring
Sportsfriends home.

Magnet Comic: A Custom Magnetic
& Dry-Erase Comic Strip

Magnet Comic: A Custom Magnetic & Dry-Erase
Comic Strip
by Erik Heumiller

Caption this
The brainchild of a cartoonist who doubles as
an art teacher, Magnet Comic is a three-panel
comic strip made funny by you. Each kit comes
with a wood-framed whiteboard, dry-erase
marker, and four magnetic characters with nine
expressions each, so you can tell stories and
crack jokes through a wide range of emotions.
Overcome with a funny idea? Just erase,
arrange, and repeat.
